# ROEH PROFILE — roeh

*Generated by the first ingest, 2026-08-16. The `oracle` and `scribe` read this to learn
what THIS project's record is shaped like. The agent definitions hold the invariant
method; everything project-specific lives here.*

---

## What this project is

roeh is a Claude Code plugin that gives a project an append-only decision trace, an
Oracle that answers "why did we do X" from that record with citations, and a scribe that
writes to it before compaction discards the reasoning. It is generalised from a working
single-project system. It is now initialised on itself, so the Oracle answering questions
about roeh is reading a record roeh produced.

## The owner

The record refers to "the owner". Published metadata uses the GitHub handle `mbrichman`.
Do not infer or record a personal name — that is itself a recorded principle here
(`e1b08ea`).

## Sovereignty posture

- **local_only:** false
- The trace is committed to a public repo. Nothing sensitive belongs in it. Note the
  asymmetry the tool itself teaches: a record of *why* is often more sensitive than the
  code it explains, so this posture is a choice specific to roeh being a public tool —
  not a default to carry into other projects.

## Vocabulary

| Term | Means |
|---|---|
| the record / the trace | `docs/decision-trace.md`, append-only |
| the gate | `PreCompact` refusing to compact while the record is behind |
| the sentinel | `roeh pending` — the order-independent PreCompact→scribe handshake |
| unit | one planned item of an ingest (`C1`, `M`, `A`), marked off as its chapter is appended |
| hall of mirrors | mining the assistant's own prose as a source, which compounds |
| dead field | a value written but never read back — this repo's signature bug |
| RECORD mode | the scribe writing unattended, dispatched by the gate |

## Standing principles (digest)

- Append-only is structural, not honour-system.
- Two records is worse than none.
- Under-claim beats confabulate.
- Assistant prose is never a source.
- Judgement is pinned; extraction is cheap.
- A guard that is never exercised is not a guard.
- Prefer loud failure to soft failure.
- Never infer personal identity from a filesystem path.

## LIVE dead-ends and reversals

| Don't re-walk | Why | Cite |
|---|---|---|
| Forbidding the scribe from writing | The objection was about `Write`/`Edit`, which truncate. `roeh append` cannot seek, and the scribe has no write tools. | `b8de529` |
| Letting `init --force` reset the config | It orphaned records and silently downgraded `local`→`repo` sovereignty. | `d58d4e6` |
| Building a `roeh update` command | The harness owns this: `claude plugin update` / `marketplace update` / `tag`. | `20914b6` |
| Re-ingesting to "refresh" the record | Append-only means a re-ingest appends beside the old chapters, not over them. Use `/roeh:refresh`. | `c31b311` |
| Putting prompt evals in `tests/run` | They call a model; the cheap tier must stay cheap or it stops being run. | `b70483e` |
| Blocking auto-compaction | The window is already full; refusing there can wedge the session. | `b8de529` |
| Trusting a sandboxed fixture to catch environment bugs | Fixtures have clean ancestors by construction; the root-resolution bug needed a dirty one. | `ddad17b` |
| Mining inline comments at HEAD | Comments go stale. Read them at their commit and cite `file:line@sha`. | `391d34c` |
| Sweeping competitive claims in the README | Several tools already read git; verify before publishing. | `b152c93` |
| Reading the FIRST `§N` heading in the trace | Append-only means sections are superseded by appending; the first is the oldest. | `bin/roeh-sessionstart` |

## Gate wiring

- **gate.enabled:** false
- The Oracle is not currently a clearance on changes here. Its GATE mode still works when
  asked directly ("any objection before I…"), and `tests/eval-prompts --case verdict`
  asserts the `VERDICT:` contract regardless.

## Where the rationale hides in this repo

**The commit bodies, overwhelmingly** — every commit message was written to carry the
why, what was rejected, and what was measured. 332 body lines across 13 commits. Mine
those first. Second: inline comments in `bin/roeh` and the hook scripts, which explain
the non-obvious guards. The agent and skill markdown carries design reasoning in prose.
There are no ADRs and no `memory/` files, and session transcripts are filed under a
different project slug (see the `[OPEN]` entry in §3).
